summary: conforms to a particular Poisson's ratio when stretched along fiber direction. κ must be large enough to enforce the Poisson function; in a biphasic representation select κ from stress-relaxation data.
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.1.4.32 Large Poisson's Ratio Ligament, p239（4.13）

example.source: pyfebio 0.3.0 默认值，已通过构造验证；数值为占位默认，建模前请按实际工况替换。
example.verified_note: 已在 FEBio 4.13.0 实测：包进 1×1×1 六面体网格、单轴压缩 1% 的算例，terminate normal。该结果只证明此 spec 可被 FEBio 正常读入并收敛，不代表参数取值适用于任何具体工况。
